about: Bazzite's ujust recipes that RedFox has its own version of, and a hash of each as RedFox's version was written. tests/check_bazzite_recipes.py compares them with the base image's. A recipe's "differences" note records what RedFox does differently on purpose, as of the last check.

install-coolercontrol.differences: Same container and settings as Bazzite (checked 2026-11-11, Bazzite b8881a9). Ours: no questions, and a desktop entry that opens the web UI.

install-openrazer.differences: Same as Bazzite (checked 2026-11-11, Bazzite b8881a9), and ours already set up razer.conf and pip --user before Bazzite did. Ours: only daemonize from pip (not gobject, which it works without), plus Polychromatic, and the root steps through redfox-hardware-root.
